units.source_text: 匂亲王睡到日高方才起身。

en.t: Prince Niou slept until the sun was high before he finally rose.

units.source_text: 他说：“母后又是身体不适，今天我要入宫请安。”

en.t: He said, "Mother is unwell again, so today I must go to the palace to pay my respects."

units.source_text: 便准备装束。

en.t: Then he began preparing his formal attire.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲又想看看，再从隙缝中窥探。

en.t: Ukifune's mother wanted to look again, so she peered once more through a crack.

units.source_text: 但见匂亲王穿上华丽的大礼服，容姿又是高贵，又是娇艳，又是清秀，无人可与比拟。

en.t: She saw Prince Niou put on his splendid ceremonial robes, and his appearance was noble, radiant, and refined beyond compare.

units.source_text: 他还舍不得小公子，只管同他玩耍。

en.t: He still could not bear to part from the little prince, and kept playing with him.

units.source_text: 后来吃过粥和饭团，便起身出门。

en.t: Later, after eating porridge and rice balls, he rose and went out.

units.source_text: 今天早上来了些人员，正在侍从室中等候，此时都上前来，向匂亲王报告。

en.t: Some attendants who had arrived that morning and were waiting in the antechamber now all came forward to report to Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 其中有一人，自己确已用心打扮，然而毫无可观之处，面目猥琐可憎，身上穿着常礼服，腰间挂着佩刀。

en.t: Among them was one man who had clearly taken pains with his appearance, yet had nothing admirable about him: his face was coarse and unpleasant, he wore ordinary court dress, and a sword hung at his waist.

units.source_text: 此人走到匂亲王面前，益觉相形见绌。

en.t: When this man stepped before Prince Niou, the contrast made him seem even more inferior.

units.source_text: 便有两个侍女相与私语，一人说：“这便是那常陆守的新女婿左近少将呀。

en.t: Then two serving women whispered to each other, and one said, "That is the Governor of Hitachi's new son-in-law, the Lesser Captain of the Left.

units.source_text: 起初定的亲是住在这里的浮舟小姐，后来他说要娶得常陆守的亲生女儿，才肯真心爱护，于是改娶了一个幼小的女童。”

en.t: At first he was betrothed to Lady Ukifune, who lives here, but later he said he would only truly cherish the Governor of Hitachi's own daughter, so he changed the match and married a very young girl."

units.source_text: 又一人说：“可是，浮舟小姐带来的人绝不谈起此事；都是常陆守方面的人在谈论呢。”

en.t: The other said, "But the people Lady Ukifune brought with her never speak of it at all; it is all the Governor of Hitachi's people who are talking."

units.source_text: 她们都没有防到浮舟的母亲听见。

en.t: Neither of them suspected that Ukifune's mother had heard them.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲听见侍女们如此议论，气得要命。

en.t: When Ukifune's mother heard the serving women gossiping like this, she was furious.

units.source_text: 回思自己以前把少将当作好男子，真是上当！

en.t: Thinking back on how she had once taken the captain for a fine man, she felt she had truly been deceived.

units.source_text: 原来他是一个毫不足取的庸人。

en.t: In truth, he was a worthless and ordinary man.

units.source_text: 她就更加看不起他了。

en.t: She despised him all the more.

units.source_text: 此时小公子匍匐而出，从帘子一端向外窥探。

en.t: Just then the little prince crawled out and peered outside from one end of the curtain.

units.source_text: 匂亲王瞥见了，又回转身，走近帘前，对二女公子说：“母后如果身体好了，我立刻就回来。

en.t: Prince Niou caught sight of him, turned back again, approached the curtain, and said to the Second Princess, "If Mother recovers, I will come back at once.

units.source_text: 如果还不见愈，我今夜就得在宫中值宿。

en.t: If she is still no better, I shall have to stay on night duty in the palace tonight.

units.source_text: 近来和你分别一夜就不自在，真难受呢！”

en.t: Lately I feel uneasy even being apart from you for one night; it is truly painful."

units.source_text: 他暂时抚慰小公子一番，便出门去。

en.t: He comforted the little prince for a while, then went out.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲偷看他的容姿，觉得异常艳丽，反复百遍也看不厌。

en.t: Ukifune's mother secretly watched his figure and found him extraordinarily beautiful, a sight she would not tire of even after looking a hundred times.

units.source_text: 他出去之后，这里顿觉岑寂了。

en.t: After he left, the place suddenly felt silent and desolate.
